name: Layered Peaks and Splashing Waterfall: Portrait of Hua Yan as a Young Man
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
summary: This portrait was jointly executed by Wei Shijie and Hua Yan himself who painted the landscape in the background. Hua Yan is shown here at the age of about 23. The sword at his back is a reference to his early desire for a military career, while the scholar’s robe suggests an opposing aspiration. To
